comment: Decline options for any question, EEO and legal included: an explicit decline in the profile maps to the form's unique option among these (docs/design/core.md §8.7). Every decline phrase is also exclusive in a multi-select. EEO-1 and VEVRAA say "I don't wish to answer", CC-305 says "I do not want to answer".
phrases: I do not wish to answer
I do not want to answer
I do not wish to self-identify
I do not wish to disclose
I do not wish to answer this question
I do not wish to provide this information
I do not want to disclose
I would prefer not to answer
